d: A cloud of toxins. Every second you stand in it poisons you, keeping your poison topped up while you stay.
Light cast by a lantern. It does nothing to whoever stands in it.
Toxic fumes. Every second you stand in them poisons you, keeping your poison topped up while you stay; the nearer their source, the stronger the poison.
Light cast by a torch. It does nothing to whoever stands in it.
Heat rising from lava. Every second you stand in it sets one of your body parts burning; the nearer the lava, the hotter it burns.
The blessing of holy ground. Every second you stand in it heals your most wounded body part; the nearer its heart, the more it heals.
The warmth of a healing shrine. Every second you stand in it heals your most wounded body part; the nearer the shrine, the more it heals.
Radiant light, as bright at its edge as at its heart. It does nothing to whoever stands in it.
Radiant light that fades with distance. It does nothing to whoever stands in it.
A null zone around an anti-magic shrine. While you stand in it you can't cast spells -- spell actions and scrolls alike -- and any spell you are winding up or holding is broken.
A null zone around an anti-literacy shrine. While you stand in it the words on scrolls and tomes swim out of reach: you can't read either.
An aura of dread around a Dread Idol. While a creature stands in it, running away weighs on its mind four times as heavily, and the fear lingers about two seconds after it leaves.
